```{r}
rm(list = ls())

# 1. LOAD LIBRARIES
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 2. CONFIGURATION BLOCK
CONFIG <- list(
  data_dir  = "Household_Economic_Burden/Inputs",
  out_dir   = "outputs",
  scenarios = c("scen_usaid", 
                "scen_usaid_gf", 
                "scen_usaid_gf_expcut_noNGO",
                "scen_usaid_USA_expcut", 
                "scen_usaid_USA"),
  scen_labels = c("USAID termination",
                  "USAID termination + Reduced GF contributions USA alone",
                  "USAID termination + terminated GF contributions USA alone",
                  "USAID termination + Reduced GF contributions",
                  "Elimination of all external TB funding"),
  quintiles = c("Poorest", "Poorer", "Middle", "Richer", "Richest"),
  bar_colors = brewer.pal(5, "Dark2"),
  quintile_colors = c("#B2182B", "#F4A582", "#92C5DE", "#2166AC", "#053061")
)

dir.create(CONFIG$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. MODULAR HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

# Module A: Concentration Index (Trapezoidal Rule)
calc_concentration_index <- function(values, pop_shares = rep(0.2, 5)) {
  y <- c(0, cumsum(values) / sum(values))
  y_mid <- (y[-1] + y[-length(y)]) / 2
  1 - sum(y_mid * pop_shares) * 2
}

# Module B: Table 1 Point Estimates
replicate_table1 <- function(quintile_df, cost_scale = 1e9, case_scale = 1e6) {
  data.frame(
    Scenario        = quintile_df[1:5, 2],
    Direct_Med_B    = round(rowSums(quintile_df[1:5, 3:7]) / cost_scale, 1),
    Direct_NonMed_B = round(rowSums(quintile_df[6:10, 3:7]) / cost_scale, 1),
    Indirect_B      = round(rowSums(quintile_df[11:15, 3:7]) / cost_scale, 1),
    Total_Cost_B    = round(rowSums(quintile_df[16:20, 3:7]) / cost_scale, 1),
    Catastrophic_M  = round(rowSums(quintile_df[21:25, 3:7]) / case_scale, 1)
  )
}

# Module C: Figure 1 Plotter (Within-Country Quintile Barplot)
plot_figure1 <- function(fig1_df, out_path, colors, labels, q_names) {
  cc_mat <- as.matrix(fig1_df[1:5, 2:6]) / 1e6
  
  png(out_path, res = 300, width = 220, height = 132, units = "mm")
  layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3, 3), ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(8, 1))
  par(mar = c(2, 5, 3, 0.8))
  
  barplot(cc_mat, main = "", ylim = c(0, 15), col = colors, xlab = "", 
          beside = TRUE, ylab = "", names.arg = q_names, 
          las = 1, cex.axis = 1, border = NA, cex.lab = 1.25)
  mtext("Households with catastrophic costs (millions)", 2, 2.5)
  
  par(mar = c(1, 0, 1, 0))
  plot.new()
  legend(x = "center", legend = labels, ncol = 2, xpd = TRUE, inset = 0, 
         bty = "n", pch = 15, cex = 1.1, col = colors, pt.cex = 2.2, 
         x.intersp = 0.8, y.intersp = 0.8)
  dev.off()
}

# Module D: Figure 2 Plotter (Catastrophic Costs vs. GDP per Capita)
plot_figure2 <- function(countries_df, cc_df, out_path, q_colors) {
  countries <- countries_df[, 2]
  q_means <- matrix(0, nrow = length(countries), ncol = 5)
  colnames(q_means) <- c("cc_poorest", "cc_poorer", "cc_middle", "cc_richer", "cc_richest")
  
  for (i in seq_along(countries)) {
    cty_sub <- cc_df[cc_df$code == countries[i], ]
    q_means[i, ] <- colMeans(cty_sub[, 2:6])
  }
  merged_df <- cbind(countries_df, q_means)
  
  png(out_path, res = 300, width = 220, height = 132, units = "mm")
  par(mar = c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), mfrow = c(1, 1), xpd = TRUE, mai = c(1, 0.8, 0.5, 0.1))
  
  cols_order <- c("cc_richest", "cc_richer", "cc_middle", "cc_poorer", "cc_poorest")
  plot(merged_df$GDPpc, merged_df[[cols_order[1]]], main = "", ylim = c(0, 1), 
       col = q_colors[1], xlab = "", ylab = "", pch = 16, las = 1, axes = FALSE)
  
  for (q in 1:5) {
    points(merged_df$GDPpc, merged_df[[cols_order[q]]], pch = 16, col = q_colors[q])
    abline(lm(merged_df[[cols_order[q]]] ~ merged_df$GDPpc), col = q_colors[q], xpd = FALSE, lty = 2)
  }
  
  axis(1, at = c(0, 4000, 8000, 12000, 16000), labels = c("$0", "$4K", "$8K", "$12K", "$16K"), cex.axis = 0.7)
  axis(2, at = seq(0, 1, 0.2), labels = c("0%", "20%", "40%", "60%", "80%", "100%"), cex.axis = 0.7, las = 1)
  title(xlab = "GDP per capita", ylab = "Percentage of TB-affected households experiencing CC\n", line = 2, cex.lab = 0.8)
  legend("top", box.col = "white", legend = c("Richest", "Richer", "Middle", "Poorer", "Poorest"),
         col = q_colors, pch = 16, cex = 0.8, horiz = TRUE, inset = c(0, -0.1), pt.cex = 1)
  dev.off()
  
  return(merged_df)
}

# Module E: Global Income Gradient & Ventile Binning (395 Strata)
analyze_global_gradient <- function(scen_df, n_bins = 20) {
  q_lower <- c("poorest", "poorer", "middle", "richer", "richest")
  
  avg_inc <- unlist(lapply(q_lower, function(q) scen_df$gdp_pc_ppp * scen_df[[paste0(q, "_share")]] / 0.2))
  cc_vals <- unlist(lapply(q_lower, function(q) scen_df[[paste0("cc_", q)]]))
  
  ranked <- data.frame(
    country = rep(scen_df$country, 5),
    code    = rep(scen_df$code, 5),
    pop     = rep(scen_df$pop, 5) / 5,
    income  = avg_inc,
    cc      = cc_vals
  )
  ranked <- ranked[order(ranked$income), ]
  
  x <- c(0, cumsum(as.numeric(ranked$pop)) / sum(as.numeric(ranked$pop)))
  y <- c(0, cumsum(ranked$cc) / sum(ranked$cc))
  global_ci <- calc_concentration_index(diff(y), diff(x))
  
  pop_fract <- cumsum(as.numeric(ranked$pop)) / sum(as.numeric(ranked$pop))
  bins <- data.frame(quantile = 1:n_bins, cumulative = NA, cc_count = NA)
  step <- 1 / n_bins
  
  for (i in 1:n_bins) {
    tmp <- sum(pop_fract < (step * i))
    w <- ((step * i) - pop_fract[tmp]) / (pop_fract[tmp + 1] - pop_fract[tmp])
    bins$cumulative[i] <- sum(ranked$cc[1:tmp]) + ranked$cc[tmp + 1] * w
  }
  bins$cc_count <- diff(c(0, bins$cumulative))
  
  poorest_20_share <- round(bins$cumulative[4] / bins$cumulative[n_bins] * 100)
  
  list(ranked = ranked, bins = bins, global_ci = global_ci, poorest_20_pct = poorest_20_share)
}

# Module F: Figure 3 Plotter (Global Distribution & Concentration Curve)
plot_figure3 <- function(global_res_list, out_path) {
  mTrsp <- function(cl, a) apply(col2rgb(cl), 2, function(x) rgb(x, x, x, a, maxColorValue = 255))
  y_max <- max(global_res_list[["scen_usaid_gf"]]$bins$cc_count)
  
  png(out_path, res = 300, width = 8, height = 10, units = "in")
  par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(3.2, 4.8, 2.0, 4.8), oma = c(2, 3, 1, 3), xpd = NA)
  
  panels <- list(
    list(key = "scen_usaid", title = "A. USAID termination", labs = FALSE),
    list(key = "scen_usaid_gf_expcut_noNGO", title = "B. USAID termination + Reduced GF contributions", labs = TRUE),
    list(key = "scen_usaid_gf", title = "C. Elimination of all external TB funding", labs = FALSE)
  )
  
  for (p in panels) {
    res <- global_res_list[[p$key]]
    plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, y_max), xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE)
    
    for (i in 1:20) {
      polygon(c(0.25, 0.25, 4.75, 4.75) + (i - 1) * 5,
              c(0, res$bins$cc_count[i], res$bins$cc_count[i], 0),
              border = FALSE, col = ifelse(i < 5, "red4", "dodgerblue"))
    }
    axis(2, las = 1, tcl = -0.25, mgp = c(3, 0.6, 0), at = seq(0, 7e6, 1e6), labels = sprintf("%.1f", 0:7))
    axis(1, las = 1, tcl = -0.25, mgp = c(3, 0.4, 0))
    
    par(new = TRUE)
    plot(cumsum(as.numeric(res$ranked$pop)) / sum(as.numeric(res$ranked$pop)) * 100,
         cumsum(res$ranked$cc) / sum(res$ranked$cc) * 100,
         type = "l", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", col = mTrsp(1, 150), lwd = 2)
    axis(4, las = 1, tcl = -0.25, mgp = c(3, 0.6, 0))
    
    mtext(p$title, 3, 1.2, adj = 0, font = 2, cex = 1.2)
    if (p$labs) {
      mtext("Households experiencing catastrophic costs (millions)", side = 2, line = 3.2, cex = 1.2)
      mtext("Cumulative percentile of households experiencing catastrophic costs", side = 4, line = 3.2, cex = 1.2)
    }
    box()
  }
  
  mtext("Percentiles of household income", side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 1.2, cex = 1.2)
  dev.off()
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. MAIN EXECUTION & VERIFICATION PIPELINE
# ==============================================================================

# Step 1: Load input datasets
quintile_raw  <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG$data_dir, "table2_quintile.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
fig1_raw      <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG$data_dir, "Figure1.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
countries_raw <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG$data_dir, "countries_included.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
cc_raw        <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG$data_dir, "cc_all.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

# Step 2: Replicate Table 1 Point Estimates
cat("\n=== TABLE 1 REPLICATION (Billions USD & Millions of Households) ===\n")
table1_out <- replicate_table1(quintile_raw)
print(table1_out)
write.csv(table1_out, file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "replicated_table1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Step 3: Replicate Within-Country Concentration Indices
total_cost_ci <- apply(as.matrix(quintile_raw[16:20, 3:7]), 1, calc_concentration_index)
cat_cost_ci   <- apply(as.matrix(quintile_raw[21:25, 3:7]), 1, calc_concentration_index)

cat("\n=== WITHIN-COUNTRY CONCENTRATION INDICES ===\n")
cat("Total Patient Costs CI (Paper reports ~ 0.14): ", round(total_cost_ci, 4), "\n")
cat("Catastrophic Costs CI  (Paper reports ~ -0.24):", round(cat_cost_ci, 4), "\n")

# Step 4: Generate Figure 1 & Figure 2
plot_figure1(fig1_raw, file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "Figure1.png"), 
             CONFIG$bar_colors, CONFIG$scen_labels, CONFIG$quintiles)

plot_figure2(countries_raw, cc_raw, file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "Figure2.png"), 
             CONFIG$quintile_colors)

# Step 5: Replicate Global Gradient (395 Strata), Global CIs & Figure 3
cat("\n=== GLOBAL EQUITY ANALYSIS (395 COUNTRY-QUINTILE STRATA) ===\n")
global_results <- lapply(CONFIG$scenarios, function(scen) {
df <- read.csv(file.path(CONFIG$data_dir, paste0("global_dist_", scen, ".csv")), check.names = FALSE)
res <- analyze_global_gradient(df)
cat(sprintf("%-30s | Global CI: %6.3f | Poorest 20%% Share: %d%%\n",
scen, res$global_ci, res$poorest_20_pct))
res
})
names(global_results) <- CONFIG$scenarios
plot_figure3(global_results, file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "Figure3.png"))
```
